subject: ist-pt
title: IST.PT.------MN.DI.
description: Diagram closing R(AS)CM(II)-8 — the section on transformation as 'making available what is available.' The prose above the diagram identifies the structural target: 'the move to expose composite creativity is a move to positively reshape society — for all people — and this must be the goal of positive transformation.' The crossing diagrams the structural mechanism by which expose-composite-creativity actually meets its political-particular conditions: (C)IST-PT (central isolated-source point — the form's working position when it is making itself available) is crossed with MN-DI (meta-direction — the directional choice the receiving culture's policy makes about which creativities are exposed). IST-PT sits centrally with the subject-arrow; MN-DU (meta-duality) rises above it and POST (postulation) sits at upper-right with OP-SD (oppositional side) below — these are the partner-side's upper outputs, the postulations and oppositions the receiving culture mobilizes. (R)INTR (the reality of introduction) anchors the left margin, with P-PROG (political progression) below it routing down through SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) and POL-P (political particulars) at the bottom-left as the subject's downward chain. T-C-IMP (temporal-continuity implication) sits centrally below as the bridging hub, with RT-ALGN (reality alignment) at the bottom-center as the bridging terminus. TR-DIF (transformation-difference) sits on the right with RET-AF-TD (return-affinity transformation-dynamics) below as the partner's downward chain. Structural argument: making-available-what-is-available reaches reshape-society only along the diagonal that runs (R)INTR → P-PROG → SOC-RT-DY → POL-P upward back into IST-PT and across to TR-DIF. The subject's downward chain on the left is the route by which introduction routes through social-reality-dynamics into the political-particular conditions for exposure. The partner's MN-DU/POST/OP-SD upper chain is what the receiving culture mobilizes against the subject — duality, postulation, oppositional-side. The diagonal from IST-PT through T-C-IMP into RET-AF-TD at the bottom-right is the only edge through which the form's making-available reaches return-affinity-transformation-dynamics, the actual mechanism of reshape. Without T-C-IMP holding that diagonal, transformation-difference produces only its partner-side outputs, and the exposure-of-composite-creativity the prose names cannot reach 'all people.'
